product.title: Columbia Gorge Waterfalls and Mount Hood Tour Full Day

description.text: Spend a full day touring Columbia River Gorge waterfalls and Mount Hood from Portland with a naturalist guide. The outing combines gorge overlooks, waterfall walks, and Mount Hood viewpoints with van transport, bottled water, and light snacks throughout the day.

highlights: Full-day gorge and Mount Hood combination tour
Waterfall stops along the Columbia River Gorge
Mount Hood scenic viewpoints and foothill driving
Naturalist guide with bottled water and light snacks
Small-group format with hotel pickup options

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Spend a full day touring Columbia River Gorge waterfalls and Mount Hood from Portland with a naturalist guide.

itineraryItems.title: Gorge waterfall stops
itineraryItems.description: Visit Multnomah Falls and additional gorge waterfalls with guided commentary.

itineraryItems.title: Mount Hood viewpoints
itineraryItems.description: Stop for mountain panoramas and photo opportunities on the Mount Hood loop.

itineraryItems.title: Hood River and orchard country
itineraryItems.description: Pass fruit-stand areas and river towns during the east-side loop.

itineraryItems.title: Return to Portland
itineraryItems.description: Drive back to the original Portland pickup point after the full-day loop.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Columbia Gorge Waterfalls and Mount Hood Tour Full Day?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 8 to 9 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Portland?
faqs.answer: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point listed in your booking confirmation.
